turns.user_utterance: I tried to withdraw cash, but the ATM rejected my card, indicating that the PIN is not being accepted.
turns.assistant_response: Sorry about that—when the ATM says your PIN isn’t being accepted, it’s usually because the PIN is entered incorrectly or the PIN may be blocked after too many attempts. Can you confirm whether you’ve tried the PIN multiple times today (and if so, how many)? Also, was the cash withdrawal declined immediately or did the ATM keep the card?

turns.user_utterance: I entered the PIN three times today, each attempt was rejected, and the ATM declined the transaction without retaining the card.
turns.assistant_response: Thanks—if you’ve entered the PIN three times and the ATM rejected every attempt without keeping the card, your PIN is very likely blocked. I can help you unblock/reset it—are you able to use the card for normal purchases, or is the PIN failing anywhere else too?
